items.title: Drag the outage risk. Watch which option comes out ahead.
items.description: Reproduces the unit's own migration decision — $50,000 outage cost, $8,000 success value if you migrate now, waiting held at its own 2% risk and $5,000 success value. Drag the outage-probability slider for "migrate now" and watch both options' expected value move. There's a crossover point: below it, migrating now actually has the better EV; above it, waiting wins. At the scenario's own 15%, waiting is already well ahead.
items.compute: const p = params.outageProbNowPercent / 100; const evNow = p * (-params.outageCost) + (1 - p) * params.successValueNow; const pLater = 0.02; const evLater = pLater * (-params.outageCost) + (1 - pLater) * 5000; return { evNow: Math.round(evNow), evLater: Math.round(evLater) };
